To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) GAs using the penalizing infeasibility solutions are more efficient than GAS using the repairing infeasible solution on average capacity knap sack problem; (ii) the efficiency of GAs is improved by the use of a larger penalty coefficient; (iii) the efficiency of GA is decreased by the increase of the average capacity of knap sack.
GAs using penalized method are less effective than GAs using repair method on average capacity problems.
GAs using the penalizing infeasibilities method are not effective for solving the average knapsack problems, and GAs using the repairing method are effective for solving the knapsack problems.
